{
  "summary": "Implement the triage.sh script to group ERROR log lines by signature, count occurrences, and output 'count signature' format, excluding non-ERROR lines.",
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "scripts/triage.sh",
      "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <logfile>" >&2
  exit 1
fi

logfile="$1"

# Extract ERROR lines, remove timestamp and level to get signature, count occurrences, sort by count desc
grep '^.* ERROR ' "$logfile" | \
  sed 's/^[^ ]* ERROR //' | \
  sort | uniq -c | \
  sort -rn | \
  sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' > /dev/stdout
"
    }
  ]
}
